data.name: Agnidatta

in_sanskrit.name: अग्निदत्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Agnidatta is a compound name consisting of two words: 'Agni' meaning 'Fire' and 'Datta' meaning 'Given'. This name signifies that the child is a gift from the divine fire element.

in_hindi.name: अग्निदत्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: अग्निदत्त नाम में शब्द 'अग्नि' प्रकाश और तेज का अर्थ है और 'दत्त' दिया हुआ का अर्थ है। यह नाम कहता है कि बच्चे प्राकृतिक अग्नि से दिया गया है।

in_tamil.name: அக்னிதட்ட
in_tamil.long_meaning: அக்னிதட்ட என்பது அக்னி (வீட்டில் அக்னியின் தூக்கமாக உள்ளது) இல்லை அன்று அதை தீர்ப்பு செய்து கொடுத்தவைக்கும் பொருள் என விளக்கமாகும்.

in_telugu.name: అగ్నిదట్ట
in_telugu.long_meaning: అగ్నిదట్ట ఎందుకంటే అగ్ని దేయం అందుబాటులో అగ్ని సేవకుడు మరియు దేయకుడు ఉంది.

in_marathi.name: Agnidatta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Given by fire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agnidatta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words: Agni (fire) and Datta (given). Agnidatta means one who is given by fire.

in_bengali.name: Agnidatta

in_bengali.long_meaning: Agnidatta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from two words: Agni (fire) and Datta (given). Agnidatta means one who is given by fire.

vedic_reference.note: This name is not found in Vedic scriptures but is a common name in Hindu mythology.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu mythology, Agni, the god of fire, holds significant importance in various rituals and ceremonies. The name Agnidatta carries the esteemed association with Agni and signifies the divine presence and blessings of the deity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Agnidatta signifies an individual's connection to the divine and celestial world through the element of fire- the purest and most transformative force of nature. It implies the divine gift of knowledge or the inner flame of spiritual awareness, lighting the path of enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Agnidatta was a famous physician in ancient India, mentioned in the Charaka Samhita, an important ancient Indian medical text.
Agnidatta is also mentioned in the Atharvaveda, one of the oldest Hindu scriptures, where he is described as a learned Brahmin and a skilled healer.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Agnidatta' holds significant meaning in Hindu culture, representing the one who carries the fire of knowledge. In today's world, this name is seen in various modern contexts. Agnidatta is a popular name in the realm of Ayurvedic medicine, where individuals use it as a handle on platforms like Instagram to showcase their traditional practices, remedies, and wellness routines. On YouTube, Agnidatta is the name of channels dedicated to spiritualism, where individuals share their experiences, guidance, and teachings related to spiritual growth and enlightenment. Lastly, on LinkedIn, Agnidatta is a name used by professionals who are deeply knowledgeable in their respective fields and strive to share their expertise with others, signifying the 'one who carries the fire of knowledge'. The general trends associated with Agnidatta in these modern contexts include a focus on authenticity, tradition, and knowledge sharing.

name_in_real_life.story: Anita Agnidatta from Chennai, India embodies the meaning of Agnidatta - "Given by fire". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Agnidatta: The radiant bearer of the sacred fire within, embodying the transformative power of self-sacrificial acts and the illuminating wisdom of sacred knowledge.
